rule T8_iam_pam {
  meta:
    author = "SOC Analyst"
  description = "Disable compromised service account svc_etl_prod and revoke OAuth tokens"
  reference = "SEC-PROC-441"
  tags = "iam pam"

  condition:
    any of them:
      service_account_name = "svc_etl_prod"
      and OAuth_token = "*",

  action:
    disable_account(service_account_name = "svc_etl_prod")
    revoke_tokens(scope = "oauth")
}
